For that same building, report (1) how many address records it has in the building-address table, (2) the average gross area value stored on the building record, and (3) how many room records it has in the rooms table. Order the results by building name.
Gold SQL (MySQL):
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 
               COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS Num_Students, 
               MAX(LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS Longest_Student_Name_Length 

FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd 
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE 
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE 

GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;
